reports.title: auto_parameters picked a recent time_range when no dates were sent (observed in our test)
reports.did: 72 searches with auto_parameters: true, a query and max_results only, for months Jan–Sep 2026
reports.happened: time_range w 57, d 14, m 1; 620 of 659 results dated October 2026, 38 undated
reports.expected: a documented default, or a warning that a historical query needs start_date/end_date
reports.fix: document the behaviour; let auto_parameters return no time_range for queries naming a past month

reports.title: auto_parameters reports a time_range that explicit dates override
reports.happened: auto_parameters echoed time_range w 47, d 8, y 1, yet 532 of 532 dated results fell inside the window
reports.expected: the echo shows the window actually applied
reports.fix: echo start_date/end_date (or drop time_range) when the caller sends dates

reports.title: published_date later than the page's own date (consistent with the documented definition)
reports.did: compared, by code (not a hand check), Tavily's published_date with the page's own published/updated date on the 42 distinct date-test pages that had both (sample: results/date_field_test.json)
reports.happened: 4 had a later published_date (3 by more than 7 days; largest gap 345 days)
reports.expected: nothing different: this is consistent with Tavily's documented definition of published_date (published or last updated, beta)
reports.fix: suggestion: separate original-publication and last-modified fields

reports.title: Map returns 0 results silently
reports.did: Map on the 5 sites of our official crawl list and 7 dairy sites, with and without instructions
reports.happened: empty results with no failed_results and no error on 5 sites of the official crawl list (merc, derc, uperc, iocl, amul) and 3 dairy sites (aavin, nandini-kmf, sanchi-indore (MPCDF union)); without instructions also empty on merc, derc, uperc, iocl; a bad start URL did get a clear error (sanchi-mpcdf)
reports.expected: an empty answer that says why (blocked, robots, nothing matched)
reports.fix: a reason field on empty Map/Crawl responses

reports.title: Scanned PDFs return only the letterhead
reports.did: Extract (basic and advanced) on Gokul's dairy rate-list PDF
reports.happened: 607 characters of letterhead; the rates are an image
reports.expected: OCR of image-only PDF pages, or a flag that the text layer is empty
reports.fix: an ocr option, or an 'image_only' flag on the result

reports.title: /usage lags per-call usage
reports.did: compared GET /usage with the per-call include_usage credits the same day
reports.happened: /usage reported plan_usage 6 while per-call include_usage credits added up to 226
reports.expected: /usage close to the sum of per-call usage
reports.fix: update /usage within minutes, or document the lag

reports.title: Nano gives no number where Super finds one on the same page
reports.did: Nano read each fetched page; where it gave no number, Super re-read the page (63 saved arm and evidence files)
reports.happened: Super re-read 1692 pages and found a verified number (the number is in the cited line) on 43 of them
reports.expected: a number whenever the cited line states one
reports.fix: a schema-level 'required number when a currency or % is present' hint, or a confidence field

reports.title: Extract reads the page as it is today (suggestion)
reports.did: 14 finance-check searches with start_date/end_date and filter_by_published_date, then an independent AI-assisted second review of every result page (post-hoc)
reports.happened: 0 of 14 searches returned a result dated after the cutoff, yet 1 page's current version leaks the outcome: R196 was dated 2026-07-07 (cutoff 2026-07-08) and updated on 2026-07-09
reports.expected: a way for a time-locked user to tell that the page Extract returns changed after the cutoff
reports.fix: an as-of / crawl-date field for Extract, so time-locked users can tell if a page changed
